main_measure.name: t of mean of forecast/10 x 24-bar excess return (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean sign(forecast) x excess return, largest |forecast| third minus smallest third

decided_by: The mean product is positive with t >= 2 and the largest-third minus smallest-third difference is > 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window) with a non-zero forecast and a 24-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's normal drift is the mean of all its grid 24-bar returns over all windows; thirds are formed by sorting cases on |forecast| (stable sort) and splitting into three near-equal groups; the plan's 500-case minimum, when not met, gives 'not observable'.
